2.original: Deliver the requested item to Savingway in the Carrotorium.

48.original: Among the Ways, there is one whose task was to preserve information. His name is Savingway, and he has since awakened to the dream of recording our voices.

49.original: To that end, he is in the midst of developing a supporter with voice-recording functionality, and has requested some components for it.

50.original: If you're willing to craft these components, please seek out Keepingway yonder. He will provide you with guidance as well as the necessary materials.

51.original: Working on Savingway's request, are you? Then you've come to the right Way!

52.original: What he needs is a component for the circuit board. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.

53.original: What he needs is a component for the organic conductor. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.

54.original: What he needs is a component for the liquid semiconductor. Here are the materials─if you require more, the doing supporter will assist you.

55.original: Once the item is ready, hop-skip over with it to Savingway. You'll find him at work in the northwest of the Carrotorium.

56.original: <blip> This supporter detects that you still have materials. Please use up your current allocation before requesting more, and remember: dreams are meaningless unless they are sustainable!

62.original: Just that one component, and the supporter will be ready for a start-up test...

63.original: Ooh, this is precisely what I need! Thank you! I'll install it at once and commence testing!

64.original: Greetings, greetings. Hail fellow well met. This is Savingway, this is Savingway.

65.original: ...That should do it. Now to see if it managed to record properly!

66.original: (-Savingway's Voice-)<buzz> Greetings, greetings. Hail fellow well met. <buzz> This is Savingway, this is Savingway.

67.original: Haha, great success! While there's some distortion, the quality is already quite serviceable, and we should be able to improve upon it!

68.original: (-Savingway's Voice-)<buzz> Greetings... Hail...well met... This...Saving... This is... <buzzzzzz>

69.original: Oh dear, that's no good at all... The audio is getting corrupted, perhaps in the course of encoding to data...

72.original: I've never heard such a horrifying sound... Is it simply data corruption, or something else? I must look into it...

73.original: Well, though much remains to be done, we've confirmed the supporter's operation. I'll keep working on my dream─the dream that everyone will be able to listen to their favorite sounds, be it a loved one's voice or a song, no matter where they are. I hope that you'll lend me a hand again!

74.original: I'll keep working on my dream─the dream that everyone will be able to listen to their favorite sounds, be it a loved one's voice or a song, no matter where they are. I hope that you'll lend me a hand again!

75.original: Well now, not only did you craft and deliver the component, you also attended the start-up test? Savingway would have appreciated that, I'm sure. I thank you as well.

76.original: Be it the hum of activity as we work or songs we love, many are the sounds worth preserving. Through efficient and effective management, I shall do my part to help Savingway realize his dream!

77.original: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
